name: hv15_dbk_cp-ring1-COMMIT
purpose: Measured reasons (hv15_dbk_cl gate on EPYC1, receipts 6d8f84699/8736a90db, evidence copied off EPYC1):   * trial GRT overflow 240 -> 318 (M6 303), concentrated at ONE 21.6 um channel (top-left / top-middle banks): every     bank carries 545 rr/wd pins on its W face, three banks shared each 21.6 um channel, rr/wd pins were ordered by bank     index instead of by bank position (cross-traffic);   * 136 reach violations = every rq bit (controller at the NE corner, rq pins on the W face: 552 um);   * all nine clock entries sat at one E-face point: bank6's raw entry wire reached 701 ps / 2,222 ps slew. Successor geometry (same R0 child views, no child re-route):   * controller in the CENTRE of a 3x3 ring of the eight banks (bank-control star <= ~260 um, rq <= ~260 um);   * channels 30.24 um (was 21.6) between columns, rows unchanged (20.52 um), >= 23.76 um from every pin face;   * rr pins grouped per bank ROW on the W face, wd pins grouped per bank COLUMN on the N face;   * every clk_bank[b] entry on the face point nearest its bank's clock pin (<= ~190 um, was <= 630 um);   * the folded dispatcher collar (2 x 128x256 SRAM + pin-registered soft logic, clocked by clk) in an E column, with     the F20 host bus and status on the E face; clk now has real soft sinks, so the parent builds a tree for it. Outline grows 511.92 -> 645.84 um wide (same 360.72 height) for the collar column: a die slot change (H-DIE).
